note: What a server sends to put the match on hold. The header names no object: it carries zero.

fields.name: clientId
fields.note: The client id of the client that asked for the hold; it applies only to a tournament's hold.

fields.name: timeLeft
fields.note: The hold time left, in seconds, for any hold. A hold begins only where it is above zero and the match is not already held.

bits.name: tournament
bits.note: Set for a tournament's hold: as the hold begins, a client shows its tournament display, crediting seat. A hold still needs timeLeft above zero.
